method: Deterministic evidence integration checks only; no artificial UI test or productive browser claim. Current source SHA256 values were compared with exact file bytes; explicit baseline values use original Git blobs. JSON detail pointers and local Markdown paths were resolved.

current_source_identity_references.scope_limit: These ledgers overlap; the count is not unique files or visually verified surfaces.

route_detail_join.scope_limit: Global families overlap concrete source files; page/state/renderer counts are not unique visually verified screens.

markdown_local_links.scope: Owned inventory/source-review Markdown and coverage.md; runtime/root-owned records validated by their owners.

commercial_source_limits: Three actual Pro derivatives match source provenance. Owner confirmed agreement covers public distribution/contributors; agreement document was not independently inspected, and Pro is not MIT. Account/authentication result is separately owned.
final_gate_limits: Source identity and link checks do not establish local all-repository gates, application builds, browser states or productive provider availability. Root/runtime final evidence remains authoritative.

concrete_route_state_file_coverage.scope: Filesystem-discovered page/layout/loading/error/not-found/global-error/global-not-found TSX files under all three first-party app trees. Separate surface-family records remain overlapping coverage dimensions.

reviewed_image_identity_references.scope_limit: Overlapping reviewer ledgers and supplemental states; image identity does not imply complete runtime or productive provider coverage.

all_indexed_image_integrity.capture_epoch_limit: Actual Next16.3.8 pre-integration browser captures; source rebase/CI does not imply new Next16.4 runtime verification.

upstream_integration_supplemental_identi.limit: Overlaps source inventories; not added as unique files or browser-verified surfaces.
